name: Hereditary Leiomyomatosis and Renal Cell Cancer Syndrome

criteria.description: Presence of multiple cutaneous piloleiomyomas confirmed by histopathology
Diagnosis of type 2 papillary renal cell carcinoma or other aggressive renal cell carcinoma subtype
Identification of pathogenic germline mutation in FH gene
Early onset multiple uterine leiomyomas in females

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of pathogenic FH gene mutation or both multiple cutaneous leiomyomas and renal cell carcinoma
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing for FH mutations is confirmatory; histopathological confirmation of skin lesions is recommended.

pathognomonic.notes: Firm, painful skin nodules typically on trunk and extremities

pathognomonic.symptomName: Aggressive type 2 papillary renal cell carcinoma
pathognomonic.notes: Often presents at younger age with rapid progression

common.notes: Frequently leads to menorrhagia and pelvic pain in affected females
Pain often triggered by cold or tactile stimuli

occasional.notes: May be secondary to anemia or malignancy
Related to renal tumor or uterine leiomyomas
Due to uterine leiomyomas in females

laboratory: Elevated serum lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) in renal carcinoma
imaging: CT or MRI showing renal masses consistent with type 2 papillary RCC
Ultrasound or MRI demonstrating multiple uterine leiomyomas
genetic: Pathogenic germline mutation in FH (fumarate hydratase) gene
other: Histopathology of skin nodules confirming piloleiomyomas
Histopathology of renal tumor showing papillary type 2 RCC features

distinguishingFeatures: Cutaneous leiomyomas without renal cell carcinoma
Presence of fibrofolliculomas and lung cysts

redFlags: Early onset aggressive renal cell carcinoma
references: Tomlinson IPM, et al. Germline mutations in FH predispose to dominantly inherited uterine fibroids, skin leiomyomata and papillary renal cell cancer. Nat Genet. 2002.
Lehtonen HJ. Hereditary leiomyomatosis and renal cell cancer (HLRCC). Rare Tumors. 2010.
Alrashidi S, et al. Hereditary leiomyomatosis and renal cell cancer syndrome: a review. Orphanet J Rare Dis. 2020.
